assets.caption: PNF0301 — Hydrostatic Test Vents & Drains, Threaded Piping V/D-01: V-01 vent and D-01 drain configurations for NPS 3/4 through 2
assets.description: Engineering drawing showing V-01 vent and D-01 drain configurations for NPS 3/4 through 2 threaded piping. Left vent diagram shows NPS 3/4 THRU NPS 2 LINE SIZE with NPS 3/4 THREADED PLUG at top and bottom and NPS 3/4 TEE OR LINE SIZE x NPS 3/4 REDUCING TEE connections. Right vent diagram shows NPS 3/4 LINE SIZE with NPS 3/4 THREADED PLUG at top and bottom and NPS 3/4 TEE. Lower section shows corresponding D-01 drain configurations.
